prompt: Which correctly creates a JFrame on the EDT with proper close behavior and centered placement?
choices: SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> { JFrame f = new JFrame("App"); f.setSize(400,300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); });
JFrame f = new JFrame(); f.setVisible(true); f.setSize(400,300);
explanation: invokeLater ensures the JFrame is created on the EDT. The sequence: create frame, set size, set close operation, center, make visible. Option C sets size after visible (may not render correctly). Option D: Thread.EDT is not real Java API.
